headline: South Korea Composite Consumer Sentiment Index Drops in October
summary: The Bank of Korea reported that the Composite Consumer Sentiment Index for October 2026 stood at 105.4, declining 1.2 points from September.
why: The Bank of Korea is South Korea's central bank, closely monitoring consumer sentiment as an indicator of domestic economic activity and inflation trends.

impacts.name: South Korean Retail
impacts.why: A lower consumer sentiment index reflects weaker household confidence, which can dampen domestic retail spending.
